### [Claude discovers a novel enzyme system](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-discovers-novel-enzyme-system)

**Anthropic** · 2026-09-24

Anthropic's new life sciences lab used Claude agents to autonomously discover a novel, uncharacterized bacteriophage enzyme system featuring a reverse transcriptase, accessory protein, and CRISPR-like repeating DNA sequences.

- The search task consumed 21 hours and 210 million tokens across roughly 950 Claude agents analyzing a massive DNA sequence database.
- Claude identified a novel enzyme system in a jumbo phage consisting of a reverse transcriptase (RT), an accessory protein of unknown function, and an associated array of non-coding DNA repeat sequences.
- Anthropic established a dedicated wet lab and biology AI research group in Spring 2026 to experimentally validate hypotheses generated autonomously by Claude.

**Why it matters:** Autonomous AI discovery of rare, structured enzyme systems could accelerate the development of novel gene-editing and biotechnology tools similar to CRISPR, restriction enzymes, and PCR.

### [Gemini 3.8 TTS Playground](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Sep/23/gemini-tts-playground/)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-09-23

Google released gemini-3.8-flash-tts and gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts models featuring over 2,000 preset voices and 30-second audio cloning capabilities.

- Introduces two text-to-speech models: gemini-3.8-flash-tts and gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts.
- Allows custom voice creation using a 30-second audio sample.
- API natively supports multi-character conversations with distinct per-character voices and style instructions.
- Generated 1 minute and 18 seconds of multi-voice audio in ~20 seconds using Flash TTS for 2.74 cents.
- Underlying Gemini API uses an open CORS policy, allowing direct client-side playground integration.

**Why it matters:** Developers can economically generate complex, multi-character audio conversations directly from client-side applications with minimal audio cloning requirements.

### [Quoting voxium](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Sep/20/voxium/)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-09-20

A anonymous post details an extreme enterprise environment where engineers across all levels (L1-L7) work 12-13 hour days using Claude Code exclusively to generate all specs, code, tests, PRDs, and tickets without reviewing them.

- Claude Code is mandated to auto-generate all software artifacts, including specs, source code, unit tests, PRDs, and ticketing updates.
- Engineers spanning L1 through L7 bands report spending 12 to 13 hours daily executing LLM prompts rather than manually writing or inspecting code.
- Management enforces high-volume output metrics under the premise that code generation is no longer a bottleneck, eliminating manual code reviews.
- Staff engineers report a complete lack of system comprehension across teams due to unverified automated code generation.

**Why it matters:** Enforcing fully automated LLM code generation without manual review inflates working hours, degrades code comprehension, and risks catastrophic software quality issues.
